crs.consequencesIfNotApproved:
UE-initiated/event-driven beam management
In clause 5.2, UE initiated CSI report procedure when reportTransmissionMode is configured as ‘ModeA’ in the CSI report configuration is unclear.

In clause 5.2.1.5.4.1, it is unclear how to reset the counter for Event-7.

In clause 6.2.1, it is unclear how to handle the case of P/SP/AP SRS in the symbol(s) where PUCCH carrying UEIRI on the same carrier is overlapped.

In clause 6.2.1.3, it is unclear how to handle the case of SRS for carrier switching on the carrier of the serving cell c_1 in the symbol where PUCCH carrying UEIRI on a carrier of a serving cell in set S(c_2 ) is overlapped.

In clause 6.2.1.3, 	it is unclear how to handle the case of SRS for carrier switching on the carrier of the serving cell c_1 in the symbol where PUSCH carrying UEI CSI report for Mode B on a carrier of a serving cell in set S(c_2 ) is overlapped.

In clauses 5.2.1.4 and 6.1.2.1, report slot offset list configuration for Mode A UEIBR may be ambiguous.

In clause 5.2.1.5.4.1a, valid transmission occasion for second channel in UEIBR mode-B be ambiguous.

In clause 6.1, UE initiated CSI report procedure when reportTransmissionMode is configured as ‘ModeA’ in the CSI report configuration is unclear.

In clause 5.2.1.5.4, The report format and corresponding definition of corresponding differential L1-RSRP field is incomplete, regarding event-1/2/7.

CSI enhancements
In clause 5.2.1.4.2, current 3GPP specification is not aligned with the agreements.

In clause 5.2.1.4.2, possible lack of clarity in UE behaviour when CJTC Dd report is linked with Rel-18 Type-II CJT.
In clause 5.2.2.2.5a, the correspondence between the bits of CBSR and SD basis vectors is incorrect.

In clause 5.2.2.2.2a, the expression of the indicators of inter-polarization co-phasing for refined Type I multi-panel codebook in TS 38.214 would be incorrect. Then the refined Type I multi-panel codebook would be generated incorrectly.
In clause 5.2.2.5, UE behavior is unclear for CSI report dropping.

In section 5.2.1.4.2, report quantities 'cjtc-Dd', 'cjtc-F', 'cjtc-Dd-F' or 'cjtc-P' and sub-configurations can be configured simultaneously. When it happens, UE does not know which information should be reported to gNB. Then UE’s reporting behavior would be unclear for gNB.

In clauses 5.2.1.4, 5.2.1.4.2, 5.2.1.4.11, incorrect subband size of phase offset report is configured. UE cannot identify whether the phase offset should be reported in the form of wideband or subband.

Support for asymmetric DL sTRP/UL mTRP scenarios
In clause 6.1, the specification leads to misunderstanding on how to determine timing adjustment for a corresponding UL transmission if a UE is configured with two TAGs and if the value of coresetPoolIndex is the same for all CORESETs if coresetPoolIndex is provided.
crs.reasonForChange:
UE-initiated/event-driven beam management
In clause 5.2, there is no description on how the UE would transmit the CSI report associated with event driven reporting, regarding mode-A. The understanding in RAN1 is that the same procedure as for aperiodic CSI reports would be used.

In clause 5.2.1.5.4.1, regarding the condition of resetting the counter of event instances, the following candidate#2 was agreed to be applied for Event-2, Event-1 and Event-7, i.e., the measured current beam RS is updated based on indicated TCI state. However, it is intuitive that current beam RS of Event-7 is just related to the activated TCI states, rather than the indicated TCI state. Consequently, the condition of resetting the counter for Event-7 has not yet been captured in the current specifications, i.e., the measured current beam RS is updated based on activated TCI states.

In clause 6.2.1, in the symbol(s) where P/SP/AP SRS is overlapped with PUCCH carrying HARQ-ACK, LRR and/or SR on the same carrier, the UE does not transmit the SRS. Consequently, given that it was agreed to reuse multiplexing/dropping rule(s) of SR as baseline for UEIRI, the same rule should be extended to the case that P/SP/AP SRS is overlapped with PUCCH carrying UEIRI on the same carrier.

In clause 6.2.1.3, when it happens that SRS for carrier switching on the carrier of the serving cell c_1 is overlapped with PUCCH carrying HARQ-ACK/positive SR/RI/CRI/SSBRI on a carrier of a serving cell in set S(c_2 ), the UE does not transmit the SRS in the same symbol. Consequently, given that it was agreed to reuse multiplexing/dropping rule(s) of SR as baseline for UEIRI, the same rule should be extended to the case that SRS for carrier switching on the carrier of the serving cell c_1 is overlapped with PUCCH carrying UEIRI on a carrier of a serving cell in set S(c_2 ).

In clause 6.2.1.3, when it happens that SRS for carrier switching on the carrier of the serving cell c_1 is overlapped with PUSCH with SP-CSI report comprising only CQI/PMI/L1-RSRP/L1-SINR on a carrier of a serving cell in set S(c_2 ), the UE does not transmit the SRS in the same symbol. Consequently, given that it was agreed to the intra-UE multiplexing/prioritization rules of PUSCH with SP-CSI for Type-1 CG PUSCH with UEI-BR for Mode B, the same rule should be extended to the case that SRS for carrier switching on the carrier of the serving cell c_1 is overlapped with PUSCH carrying UEI CSI report for Mode B on a carrier of a serving cell in set S(c_2 ).

In clauses 5.2.1.4 and 6.1.2.1, in RAN1#122b meeting, a new RRC parameter indicating timing offset for UE initiated CSI reporting for Mode A using PUSCH is introduced. Accordingly, report slot offset list configured for Mode A UEIBR should be captured in the specification for clarity.

In clause 5.2.1.5.4.1a, in RAN1#121 is for clarifying the ‘available’ transmission occasion of the second UL channel which is not clearly captured in the specifications.

In clause 6.1, there is no description on how the UE would transmit the CSI report associated with event driven reporting, regarding mode-B. The understanding in RAN1 is that the same procedure as for aperiodic CSI reports would be used.

In clause 5.2.1.5.4, the agreed corresponding reference of differential value are not specified.

In clauses 5.2.1.5.4.1, the following RAN1#123 agreement needs to be implemented:

Agreement: 
Regarding triggering event determination, besides for Candidate#2, Candidate#7 is additionally supported for resetting the counting.
Candidate#7: The RRC parameter(s) of the threshold for event evaluation in Event-1/2/7, the value of Q in Event-7, eventInstanceCount and/or eventDetectionTimeWindowLength are reconfigured for the CSI report configuration for UEI beam report.
In such case, the UE needs to reset the counting for all new beams.
Note: Candidate#2: The measured current beam RS is updated based on indicated TCI state


CSI enhancements
In clause 5.2.1.4.2, it is agreed that the Rel-18 NES is not supported for multi-CRI report, but current spec allows the Type1 codebook based single-CRI report and multi-CRI report.

In clause 5.2.1.4.2, it was agreed that CJTC Dd report can be linked with Rel-18 Type-II CJT, which implies that the CQI/PMI calculation for Rel-18 Type-II CJT can be configured to assume a previously reported CJTC Dd report. Analogous to Rel-19 Type-II CJT mode-1, this can be reflected in the CQI/PMI calculation equation. However, the current description in TS38.214 may be unclear. 

In clause 5.2.2.2.5a, the following conclusion was achieved at the last RAN1 meeting. According to the conclusion, it can be derived that a bit of CBSR sequence is associated with  SD basis vectors, where the values  are configured by the higher layer parameters valueOfX1-typeII-CBSR-r19 and valueOfX2-typeII-CBSR-r19, respectively.
However, in the current specification, the vector group  contains  SD basis vectors, which contradicts the conclusion (clause 5.2.2.2.5a)
In clause 5.2.2.5, CSI report dropping behavior is specified for the cases when Rel-19 extend-ed Type-I SP, Type-I MP, eType-II, FeType-II-portseletion, or eType-II Doppler codebook is configured. However, the codebook type is configured by RRC parameter codebookType rather than reportQuantity.

In clause 5.2.2.2.2a, the indicators of inter-polarization co-phasing rules for refined Type I multi-panel codebook is resource-common. But according to the agreement in RAN1#117 meeting, the inter-polarization co-phasing should be resource specific, and according to the agreement in RAN1#118 meeting, co-phasing for each resource is based on legacy Rel-15 Type-I SP codebookMode=1 for PCSI-RS<16. However, the inter-polarization co-phasing across the 2/4 aggregated resources in current TS 38.214 satisfies:

This indicates that the inter-polarization co-phasing is common across the 2/4 aggregated resources, which clearly contradicts previous agreements.
In clauses 5.2.1.4.2, 5.2.3, 5.2.4, higher layer parameter mrSelectedResources is used to indicate M_R<M CSI-RS resources to be selected for reporting, which is not aligned with the parameter mr-SelectedResources in TS 38.331.
In clause 5.2.1.4.2, if the UE is configured with a CSI-ReportConfig that contains a list of sub-configurations, provided by csi-ReportSubConfigToAddModList, the report quantities that UE does not expect to be configured introduced are specified. In Rel-19, some new report quantities are introduced. Specifically, the following new report quantities are introduced in Rel-19 for CJT calibration: 'cjtc-Dd', 'cjtc-F', 'cjtc-Dd-F' or 'cjtc-P'. Since there is no agreement that the report quantities of CJT calibration can be configured when the UE is configured with NES, the report quantities that UE does not expect to be configured for NES should cover the new report quantities introduced for CJT calibration in Rel-19.
In clauses 5.2.1.4, 5.2.1.4.2, 5.2.1.4.11, if the UE is configured with a CSI-ReportConfig with the higher layer parameter reportQuantity set to 'cjtc-P', the granularity of phase offset report is given by the higher layer parameter subbandSize. However, the higher layer parameter subbandSize is used to configure the subband size of PMI report. The granularity of phase offset report should be given by the higher layer parameter subbandSizeCJTC in current TS 38.331, which is a different parameter from the subband size of PMI report.
Support for 3TX CB-based Uplink
In clauses 6.2.1 and 6.2.1.2, some RRC parameter names are not correct!

Support for asymmetric DL sTRP/UL mTRP scenarios
In clause 6.1, if a UE is configured with two TAGs and is not configured with multi-DCI based mTRP, each TCI-State or TCI-UL-State is associated with a TAG for determining timing adjustment for a corresponding UL transmission. A condition representing UE is not configured with multi-DCI based mTRP, i.e., if the value of coresetPoolIndex is the same for all CORESETs if coresetPoolIndex is provided, is not captured in specification.

In clauses 5.2.1.4 and 6.1.2.1, clarified report slot offset list configured for Mode A UEIBR.

In clause 5.2.1.5.4.1a, clarified ‘available’ transmission occasion of the second UL channel configured for Mode B.

In clause 6.1, the UE behavior of UEI CSI reporting when reportTransmissionMode is configured as ‘ModeA’ in the CSI report configuration is to reuse that for PUSCH with aperiodic CSI reports, unless otherwise stated.

In clause 5.2.1.5.4, clarified the reference of deriving the differential RSRP in a report instance.

In clauses 5.2.1.5.4.1, implemented a missing agreement.

CSI enhancements
In clause 5.2.1.4.2, clarified the CSI sub-report configuration only supports single-CRI report.

  In clause 5.2.1.4.2, added a new paragraph in clause 5.2.1.4.2 when CJTC Dd report is linked with Rel-18 Type-II CJT.
In clause 5.2.2.2.5a, introduced O1 and O2 into the subscript indices of vector v.

  In clause 5.2.2.5, modified ‘reportQuantity’ to ‘codebookType’.

In clause 5.2.2.2.2a, the correct description of the quantities  and , for  are provided. A formula of  is added and Table 5.2.2.2.2a-3 is changed to support reporting the inter-polarization co-phasing indicators independently in each resource.

In clauses 5.2.1.4.2, 5.2.3, 5.2.4, changed the parameter mrSelectedResources in clause 5.2.1.4.2, 5.2.3 and 5.2.4 in TS 38.214 into mr-SelectedResources to align with parameter in TS 38.331.

In section 5.2.1.4.2, included the report quantities introduced for CJT calibration in Rel-19 to the list that UE does not expect to be configured when UE is configured with sub-configurations in clause 5.2.1.4.2 in TS 38.214.

In clauses 5.2.1.4, 5.2.1.4.2, 5.2.1.4.11, changeed the parameter subbandSize in clause 5.2.1.4, 5.2.1.4.2 and 5.2.4.2.11 into subbandSizeCJTC to align with parameter in TS 38.331.

Support for 3TX CB-based Uplink
In clauses 6.2.1 and 6.2.1.2, updated RRC parameter names!
